title: One iOS standard for every iOS repo
why: Your reframe, Oct 27: "i never intended for the way i use these repos' interaction with ios/phone etc to be different ... i'm assuming there's best practices from each."

Known drift: home-app CI pins macos-latest (360a31f); ios-adblock builds in Swift 5.0 mode, 6 files (78fb749). Not worth matching: XCTest against Swift Testing. Part 1, claude-settings (the page and the compliance-check rows), needs no answer.
